_meta.purpose: URLs that must be answerable. Fed to src/scripts/audit_coverage.py to check that a crawl strategy can actually reach them, because a page the crawler never considers leaves no trace in any failure count.
_meta.how_to_extend: When an answer is wrong or stale, find the page a search engine returns for that question, add it here with a note, and run the audit. If it reports BLIND SPOT, the strategy needs a path pattern, not a re-ingest.

sources.note: Annual EU Blue Card salary thresholds in euros (2026: 50.700 / 45.934,20). The statute gives only the percentage; this is where the figure lives.
§ 18g AufenthG — Blaue Karte EU. The percentage rule (50% / 45.3% of the Beitragsbemessungsgrenze) and Abs. 7, which says the ministry publishes the euro figures annually.
BeschV § 6 — Positivliste / shortage occupations, the legal basis for the reduced threshold.
Plain-language Blue Card guidance. Bot-blocked as of 2026-09: returns a browser challenge, so expect it to stay absent until a headless fetch exists.
